question: A delivery company reports "98% of parcels on time", yet one town keeps complaining. What is the best first step to understand the complaints?
options: Open the tracking history of a few late parcels to that town
Report the average delivery time instead
Check how busy the trucks' engines were
Wait until the on-time share falls below 98%
explanation: The 98% is a summary over all parcels; the late ones can all go to one town without moving it much. The tracking history of a late parcel shows each stop with its time, so you can see where it waited, like a trace. Engine load is a cause that may not matter, and an average hides the late parcels even more.
